findings.title: Case 12 requires a fourth ENTER that the unchanged probe never stores
findings.evidence: Case12 declares four updates. The unchanged probe increments its update counter for each call but stores SERVER_ENTER/CLIENT_ENTER/CLIENT_EXIT only while per-entity updates<=ENVE_ENTERS_STORED (3; line438). Lua requires w.enters==calls, hence a real coherent calls=4/report.updates=4 with only three stored ENTERs is rejected. New pause_report emits an ENTER for all four made steps, so its canned positive does not model the real probe.
findings.impact: The planned original case12 characterization cannot pass its real unchanged probe even if the original routines complete correctly.

findings.title: Scan counts can contradict the cohort states and still produce a healthy result
findings.evidence: For pause/resume steps the validator checks of_type==matching, unchanged total/of_type and valid/invalid differences equal the return count. It never checks absolute valid/invalid/linked counts against adjacent state rows or even valid+invalid==of_type and total>=of_type. linked_of_type is only parsed. In case11, changing only the first scan linked_of_type=1 to0 is accepted despite the same entity before the call having member=1. Adding1 to both before/after valid_of_type also preserves its checked delta and is accepted while disagreeing with the captured validity. Existing fourteen damaged forms do not cover these contradictions.
findings.impact: A self-contradictory report about the central pause/resume/list-membership observations can be labeled complete; the stated scan/cohort joins are incomplete.
findings.requested_change: For both before and after scans, check internal count bounds and join matching-subtype valid/invalid/linked counts to the corresponding cohort state tag (the existing of_type==cohort match requirement already establishes attribution). Add finite damaged forms for contradictory linked count, absolute validity offset and impossible total/count split, with coherent unrelated other-subtype children retained. Describe the scanned structure accurately as the session special-effect child list, bounded by number_of_entities, rather than a whole entity-table scan.
